result.explanation: Maintain the current clock, active owner, lease deadline, and highest issued generation. Advance first changes time, then expiration is checked before the operation. Acquisition is vacant-only; renewal and release require the exact owner and generation.
result.mapping: config.ttl maps to lease duration; state stores now, owner, generation, and expires. Each event produces the documented status snapshot.
result.assumptions: Inputs satisfy the stated schema and safe-integer bounds. Event identifiers are compared by ordinary JSON string equality.
result.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!applies(input)||!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;var t=0,o=null,g=0,x=null,ttl=input.config.ttl;for(var i=0;i<input.events.length;i++){var e=input.events[i],status;if(e.type==='advance'){t+=e.dt;status='advanced';}else if(e.type==='acquire'){if(x!==null&&x<=t){o=null;x=null;}if(o===null){g++;o=e.owner;x=t+ttl;status='acquired';}else status='busy';}else if(e.type==='renew'){if(x!==null&&x<=t){o=null;x=null;}if(o!==null&&o===e.owner&&g===e.generation){x=t+ttl;status='renewed';}else status='ignored';}else if(e.type==='release'){if(x!==null&&x<=t){o=null;x=null;}if(o!==null&&o===e.owner&&g===e.generation){o=null;x=null;status='released';}else status='ignored';}else return false;var z=output[i];if(!z||z.status!==status||z.now!==t||z.owner!==o||z.generation!==g||z.expires!==x)return false;}return true;}
